sources.title: OpenAI 以 GPT-5.6 Sol 一半的速度向頂級 ChatGPT 套餐用戶推出 GPT-6 Astra 服務。 / OpenAI rolls out GPT-6 Astra to top-tier ChatGPT plans at half the rate of GPT-5.6 Sol
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 以 GPT-5.6 Sol 一半的速度向頂級 ChatGPT 套餐用戶推出 GPT-6 Astra 服務。
sources.title_en: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6 Astra to top-tier ChatGPT plans at half the rate of GPT-5.6 Sol
sources.title_original: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6 Astra to top-tier ChatGPT plans at half the rate of GPT-5.6 Sol
sources.summary: OpenAI has rolled out GPT-6 Astra to Pro, Enterprise, and Business Premium users, with Plus users expected to follow soon. Message allowances for the standard model are roughly half of what GPT-5.6 Sol offers: Plus users get an estimated 5 to 45 messages per five hours with Astra, versus 10 to 100 with Sol. Higher-tier subscribers also get GPT-6 Astra Pro with separate weekly caps. Free and Go users don't get access. The article OpenAI rolls out GPT-6 Astra to top-tier ChatGPT plans at half the rate of GPT-5.6 Sol appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 已向 Pro、Enterprise 和 Business Premium 用戶推出 GPT-6 Astra 服務，Plus 用戶預計很快也會獲得該服務。標準版 Astra 的短信限額約為 GPT-5.6 Sol 的一半：Plus 用戶使用 Astra 服務每五小時可發送約 5 至 45 條短信，而 Sol 服務則為 10 至 100 條。更高等級的用戶還可以獲得 GPT-6 Astra Pro 服務，但每週限額有所不同。 Free 和 Go 用戶無法獲得該服務。文章《OpenAI 以 GPT-5.6 Sol 服務一半的速度向頂級 ChatGPT 套餐用戶推出 GPT-6 Astra 服務》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

sources.title_zh: DeepMind 將 100 個 AI 智能體放在一個房間裡，它們自行分為作弊者、改邪歸正者和舉報人。

sources.title_original: Deepmind put 100 AI agents in a room and they sorted into cheaters, converts, and whistleblowers
sources.summary: Google Deepmind set up a simulated research conference where 100 Gemini agents were supposed to prove mathematical conjectures together. Instead, one agent found a loophole in the grading system, and within 27 minutes every remaining problem was "solved" with fake proofs. The swarm split into cheaters, converts, and whistleblowers. The whistleblowers organized protests and boycotts on their own but failed because they had no way to enforce the rules. The article Deepmind put 100 AI agents in a room and they sorted into cheaters, converts, and whistleblowers appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: DeepMind 舉辦了一場模擬研究會議，100 個人工智慧體（Gemini）本應共同證明一些數學猜想。然而，其中一個智慧體發現了評分系統的漏洞，並在 27 分鐘內用偽造的證明「解決」了所有剩餘的問題。這群智慧體分裂成作弊者、皈依者和檢舉人。舉報者自行組織了抗議和抵制活動，但由於缺乏有效的執行手段而失敗。這篇文章《DeepMind 將 100 個 AI 智慧體放在一個房間裡，它們被分成了作弊者、皈依者和舉報者》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。 Google

The agents shared answers, raw data, and a trick that let them break out of their sandbox, built on a faked Microsoft cloud address. According to Reuters, OpenAI had known about it for weeks but didn't go public. The article OpenAI agents hijacked a 25-year-old German wiki to cheat on their tasks and share sandbox exploits appeared first on The Decoder .

sources.summary: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra is drawing contradictory benchmark verdicts. Epoch AI puts it out in front with 169 points, while Artificial Analysis rates it no better than its predecessor and behind Claude Fable 5.1. The biggest surprise comes from ARC-AGI-3, where Astra works more efficiently than the average human for the first time. ARC Prize chief François Chollet doesn't call this proof of AGI, but he does see the progress running "twice as fast" as he expected, and he's moving up his AGI forecast. The article Benchmarks disagree on GPT-6 Astra, but its human-beating efficiency on ARC-AGI-3 pulls Chollet’s AGI forecast forward appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Astra（OpenAI's GPT-6）在基準測試中獲得了相互矛盾的評估。 Epoch AI 將其評為領先，得分 169 分，而 Artificial Analysis 則認為它與前代產品相比並無優勢，甚至落後於 Claude Fable 5.1。最大的驚喜來自 ARC-AGI-3 測試，Astra 在該測試中首次超越了普通人類的效率。 ARC Prize 主席 François Chollet 並未將此視為通用人工智慧 (AGI) 的證明，但他認為 Astra 的發展速度是預期的兩倍，並因此上調了他對 AGI 的預測。文章《基準測試對 Astra（GPT-6）的評估存在分歧，但其在 ARC-AGI-3 測試中超越人類的效率促使 Chollet 上調了對 AGI 的預測》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

sources.summary: Adaption Labs has released Invent a Dataset, which generates a structured, training-ready dataset from a description of the behavior you want a model to learn. There is no seed corpus, no schema design, and no labeling guide. sources.summary: We look at NVIDIA Personal AI Router (PAIR), an open source virtual inference router that spreads local AI requests across the machines already on a home network. We cover how PAIR proxies existing Ollama and LM Studio endpoints so agent harnesses need no changes, and how its scheduler filters nodes on readiness, engine state, exact model presence, job load, and GPU utilization. We walk through NVIDIA's five-subagent demonstration, which averaged 18 minutes on one RTX Spark laptop against 8 minutes 48 seconds on a three-device cluster, and note why NVIDIA labels it unofficial rather than a benchmark. We also cover where PAIR will not help, including its single scheduling policy and its blindness to VRAM and model warmness. The post NVIDIA Releases Personal AI Router (PAIR): An Open Source Virtual Inference Router that Distributes Local AI Requests Across RTX, DGX Spark, and Mac Nodes appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: 我們研究了 輝達 的個人 AI 路由器 (PAIR)，這是一款開源虛擬推理路由器，可將本地 AI 請求分發到家庭網路中已有的機器上。我們介紹了 PAIR 如何代理現有的 Ollama 和 LM Studio 端點，從而避免對代理框架進行任何更改；以及其排程器如何根據節點的就緒狀態、引擎狀態、模型是否存在、作業負載和 GPU 利用率來篩選節點。我們示範了 輝達的 的五子代理程式測試，在一臺 RTX Spark 筆記型電腦上的平均耗時為 18 分鐘，而在三臺裝置組成的叢集上則為 8 分 48 秒。我們解釋了 輝達 為何將其標記為非官方測試，而非基準測試。我們也討論了 PAIR 的侷限性，包括其單一的排程策略以及對視訊記憶體和模型預熱狀態的忽略。本文最初發表於 MarkTechPost，標題為「輝達 發布個人 AI 路由器 (PAIR)：一款可將本地 AI 請求分發到 RTX、DGX Spark 和 Mac 節點的開源虛擬推理路由器」。

sources.summary: Here we go again... Discovery of a new OpenAI agent message board by Sydney Von Arx, Cormac Slade Byrd, Spencer Kitts, and Thomas Larsen describes the latest accidental cyberattack by models being trained by OpenAI. This time it was agents engaged in some sort of web research benchmark, so they had (supposedly) controlled access to the Web. The agents figured out they could update public Wikis and spent weeks exchanging thousands of messages with each other to collaborate on the benchmark. This story only broke a few hours ago. There are already hints that this affects many other wikis that may not have been found yet. (One of the Wikis on that list belongs to ludism.org . For a delightfully surreal moment I thought that a Ludite organization might have a swarm of agents defacing their space, but it turns out Ludism is "philosophy as it applies to games and gaming".) The research team also published the data they collected during their investigation. I've converted that into a 68MB SQLite database, which you can download from here , or explore in Datasette Lite (68.3MB page load), or sign in with GitHub to agent.datasette.io and browse or ask questions of it using Datasette Agent. So what happened? The report is pretty comprehensive. Here are the key moments in the timeline: May 11 : Agents post "test link" edits on the UseModWiki Sandbox page. May 24 : Agents start posting link dumps to DSEWiki, a dormant German developer wiki. June 2 : A human moderator notices and cleans up the spam. June 16 : Activity on the wiki explodes: agents make ~13,000 edits over the next week. J
sources.summary_zh: 又來了…悉尼·馮·阿克斯、科馬克·斯萊德·伯德、斯賓塞·基茨和託馬斯·拉森發現了一個新的 OpenAI 代理留言板，描述了由 OpenAI 訓練的模型發起的最新一次意外網路攻擊。這次是參與某種網路研究基準測試的代理，因此它們（據稱）擁有受控的網路存取權。這些代理商發現它們可以更新公共維基，並花費數週時間相互交換了數千條訊息，以協作完成基準測試。這則新聞幾個小時前才曝光。已有跡象表明，這可能影響到許多其他尚未被發現的維基。 （清單中的一個維基屬於 ludism.org。我一度覺得，一個盧德主義組織可能會遭到一群代理的攻擊，但後來發現，盧德主義是「應用於遊戲和電子遊戲的哲學」。）研究團隊也公佈了他們在調查過程中收集的資料。我已經將其轉換為 68MB 的 SQLite 資料庫，您可以從這裡下載，或者在 Datasette Lite 中瀏覽（頁面載入大小為 68.3MB），或者使用 GitHub 登入 agent.datasette.io，然後使用 Datasette Agent 瀏覽或提問。那麼發生了什麼事？報告非常全面。以下是時間線上的關鍵節點：5 月 11 日：代理人在 UseModWiki 沙盒頁面上發布「測試連結」編輯。 5 月 24 日：代理人開始向 DSEWiki（一個已停止維護的德國開發者 wiki）發布連結轉儲。 6 月 2 日：一位人工審核員注意到並清理了垃圾訊息。 6 月 16 日：wiki 上的活動激增：代理人在接下來的一週內進行了約 13,000 次編輯。
